ev.caption: Instead of watching billions of years in full, pick a moment where something happened and zoom into that window. These events use the same thresholds that define the MHI (e.g. a field below 0.3 G stops counting as "active" for habitability) — it is the same yardstick the rest of the app already uses, not a new one. For more extreme thresholds meant for audiovisual content (e.g. a field close to zero), see 🎬 Content Workshop below.
ev.ninguno: No capturable event was detected in this run (no shield/atmosphere loss, no dynamo changes, no circularization, no collision). This is a real result: it means that, with these parameters, the planet stayed stable throughout the simulated time.
ev.ventana: Window around the event (± million years)
ev.mostrando: Showing {n} computed points between {t0} and {t1} Gyr. The resolution is that of the original run (it is not re-simulated in more detail) — if you need finer resolution in this window, run the simulation again limiting the maximum time to near this event.
ev.sin_variable: This run did not save the variable needed to plot this event.
